title: Sivochka Ihor — games, teaching and collecting
description: The personal website of Sivochka Ihor (Figarist): game development, projects, blog and collection. Individual online Unity, Python and computer science lessons.
heading: Create, teach, collect.
intro: I am Sivochka Ihor, also known as Figarist. I develop games, teach and build my collection. This is a home for my projects, interests and things I want to share.
teaching_intro: I help children and teenagers understand programming and create their own projects. Unity and C# are my main focus. We choose a starting point around each student's interests and experience.
explore_intro: Games, posts, learning materials and items from my collection — different parts of one personal website.
collection: Technology and games from my personal collection
